summary: OpenAI-compat streaming: intermittent premature termination / missing [DONE] (AsterixPay)
description:
Issue summary
AsterixPay reports intermittent truncated Server-Sent Events (SSE) streams on the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Client receives some tokens, then stream stalls and connection closes without a final `[DONE]` event. HTTP status is often 200 with partial content.

Impact
~0.5% of requests, but user-visible partial answers. Customer retries can cause duplicate token spend and degraded UX.

Environment
- Product: Hosted API
- Endpoint: `/v1/chat/completions` with `stream=true` (OpenAI-compatible)
- Region: eu-west (customer says repro higher in EU)
- Client: Node OpenAI SDK and also raw fetch + SSE parsing (both affected)

Steps to reproduce
1) Use OpenAI-compat endpoint with streaming.
2) Observe occasional streams that end without `[DONE]` and without final event containing `finish_reason`.

Customer-provided signals
- Request ids (examples): req_9f1cXXXX (2025-02-10 ~21:13 UTC), req_2a77XXXX (2025-02-11 ~09:02 UTC)
- Symptom: tokens flow for a few seconds, then ~10-20s silence, then socket close.

Investigation notes
- Hypothesis: proxy/gateway idle timeout or buffering on OpenAI-compat path (HTTP/1.1 SSE).
- Check: gateway logs for FIN/RST, upstream timeouts, and any `stream_flush` gaps.

Comments
- 2025-02-11 Dev Patel: Can we confirm if responses include `transfer-encoding: chunked` and whether `Cache-Control: no-transform` is set on SSE?
- 2025-02-12 Lauren Bishop: Customer sees the issue even bypassing Cloudflare once; likely server-side.
- 2025-02-13 Dev Patel: Found correlation with `sse_flush_interval_ms=250` and a period of no upstream tokens; gateway may trip idle timeout. Working on mitigation (send heartbeat comments).
- 2025-02-14 Dev Patel: Proposed fix: emit SSE comment heartbeat every 5s when upstream is quiet + set gateway `proxy_read_timeout` higher for OpenAI-compat streaming route in eu-west. Rolling out behind flag.

Workaround
- Customer can implement client-side retry if `[DONE]` not received; also log request id + last event id. (Not ideal; duplicates token usage.)

Next actions
- Roll out heartbeat/timeout tuning in eu-west first, then global.
- Add known-issue entry and status page note if customer impact continues.
